what_this_is: What Notrios 1.0 supports, limited to what was executed at 1.0.0. It is v0.9 I7's matrix with each row made exact: the browser and its version, the operating system release, and the libraries each binary needs, taken from the built package rather than written by hand. A level changed only where something was executed.
the_rule_this_matrix_follows: A platform is supported when it has been installed and executed and somebody commits to keeping it working. Everything else is named with its level and its blocker. Windows and macOS are absent from release claims rather than listed as forthcoming.
claim_ladder: performance/v0.8-h6a/FINDINGS.json -- 1 generated, 2 structurally inspected, 3 natively installed and executed, 4 supported (3 plus a maintainer's commitment)

hosts.workstation: The development machine. It ran Ubuntu 24.04 until 2026-09-29, when it was upgraded to 26.04 (the upgrade log reads 'Upgrading from noble to resolute'), and runs Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS since. Evidence recorded on it before that date is 24.04 evidence; evidence after it is 26.04 evidence.
hosts.containers: Clean ubuntu:24.04 containers with no source tree, Go, Node or compiler, run as an unprivileged user (v0.9 I3's harness). Reported by the image as Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, glibc 2.39.
hosts.release_runner: GitHub's hosted runner. Run 34697727452, the rehearsal J1 and J2 verified, ran on the ubuntu-24.04 image.
